questions.q: During Jesus' Triumphant Entry into Jerusalem, which animal did He ride, fulfilling the prophecy of Zechariah?
options: A chariot pulled by two oxen
questions.explain: Matthew 21:5 quotes Zechariah: "Say to the daughter of Zion, 'Behold, your king is coming to you, humble, and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden.'"

questions.q: As Jesus rode into Jerusalem (Matthew 21:1-11), the crowds spread their cloaks and branches on the road. What traditional phrase did they shout in praise?
options: "Hail to the King of the Jews!"
"Worthy is the Lamb who was slain!"
questions.explain: The crowds that went before him and that followed were shouting, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

questions.q: The Last Supper (Matthew 26:17-30) took place during the preparation for which major Jewish festival?

questions.q: During the Last Supper, Jesus instituted the Holy Communion. What did He say the cup of wine represented?
options: His blood of the covenant, poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins
His physical suffering and sweat in the Garden of Gethsemane
The water of life that purifies the disciples
The bitter tears He would shed in Jerusalem
questions.explain: Jesus took a cup, and when he had given thanks he gave it to them, saying, "Drink of it, all of you, for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins." (Matthew 26:27-28)

questions.q: Which of Jesus' disciples went to the chief priests and agreed to betray Him for thirty pieces of silver?

questions.q: When the armed crowd arrived to arrest Jesus in the garden (Matthew 26:47-56), what predetermined sign did His betrayer use to point Him out?
options: He pointed a spear at Him.
He greeted Jesus with a kiss.
He tied a rope around Jesus' hands.
questions.explain: The betrayer had given them a sign, saying, "The one I will kiss is the man; seize him." He came up to Jesus at once and said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed him.

questions.q: During Jesus' trial before the Jewish council (Sanhedrin), the high priest put Jesus under oath to say whether He was the Christ, the Son of God. Who was this high priest?
questions.explain: Matthew 26:57 records that those who had seized Jesus led him to **Caiaphas** the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had gathered.

questions.q: While Jesus was inside facing the council, Peter was waiting in the courtyard. What did Peter do when recognized by servant girls and bystanders?
options: He drew his sword and fought them.
He bravely declared his loyalty to Jesus.
He wept openly and begged for mercy.
He denied knowing Jesus three times.
questions.explain: Fulfilling Jesus' exact prediction, Peter was confronted three separate times and denied knowing Him on each occasion before the rooster crowed (Matthew 26:69-75).

questions.q: As the soldiers led Jesus away to be crucified, they forced a man passing by to carry His cross. What was this man's name? (Matthew 27:32)
questions.explain: Matthew 27:32 says, "As they went out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name. They compelled this man to carry his cross."

questions.q: Immediately after Jesus cried out with a loud voice and yielded up His spirit on the cross, what dramatic physical event happened in the temple at Jerusalem? (Matthew 27:50-51)
options: The bronze altar shattered into pieces.
All the candles in the temple instantly went out.
The curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.
The roof of the temple collapsed inward.
questions.explain: When Jesus died, Matthew 27:51 records: "And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom. And the earth shook, and the rocks were split." This symbolized open access to God through Christ's death.
